newsitem.title: DUBAI: Bank shares lead trade on Omani bourse in week.
newsitem.headline: Bank shares lead trade on Omani bourse in week.

text.p: Oman stocks ended the week to Wednesday with banking and investment stocks pushing the index to 219.92 points from 217.88 points two weeks ago, the Muscat Securities Market (MSM) said.
The week's total trade value reached 11.45 million rials ($30 million), down on 12.38 million rials two weeks earlier.
The usual trading week was interrupted for several days by the Eid al-Fitr feast marking the end of the Moslem fasting month of Ramadan.
Some 4.785 million shares were traded in the week compared with 5.62 million shares in the previous close.
Of the 55 companies traded, 28 rose, 10 were unchanged and 17 dropped.
National Bank of Oman led the market with more than 603.000 shares worth 2.630 million rials traded. The share ended the week up at 4.590 rials from a previous 4.140 rials.
